name: zero-slop
description: Edits AI-assisted prose through one careful workflow with a local writing check, contextual editing, fact protection, fresh final editors, and private learning from writer edits.

interface.shortDescription: Remove AI-sounding prose. Keep every fact. Verify the result.
interface.longDescription: Zero Slop checks a draft locally, points to exact phrases, reads the text in context, protects facts, and runs separate copy-editing and read-aloud passes. It can learn privately from later writer edits without retraining the AI model. Research experiments stay outside the installed workflow. Draft checks stay local and need no additional packages; the optional version check sends only a version query.
